issue.description:
Slice 4 of 4 of the beadrs-40f0cc4e auto-split. Depends on slice 3. This slice produces the combined acceptance evidence the umbrella parent needs to close. It exists as its own slice because the full suite is a ~306s run plus fmt/clippy — sized past what a fix-and-verify dispatch finishes before its watchdog — and because the shared checkout cannot produce clean clippy while rival WIP is in flight.

Scope: from a fresh git-archive extraction of main with all four slices landed, private target dir as a subdir of /build/bead-rs/, fresh TMPDIR outside the extraction (never /tmp or /var/tmp — stray .beads there): run the whole set-v2 conformance suite (all 8 scenarios including set-v2-budget-single-issue-update) plus the scoped tests for the touched checkpoint targets, then fmt --check and clippy over those targets. Write the evidence verbatim on this bead and on the parent beadrs-40f0cc4e, then close this bead. The parent close happens on the parent (umbrella) once this child closes.

Acceptance:
- One combined run: all 8 scenarios pass (7 conformance + byte-budget), scoped checkpoint target tests pass, fmt and clippy clean on those targets, exit codes recorded verbatim on the bead.
- Byte-budget assertion confirmed at its bound: <= 256 KiB of new blob bytes per 100 consecutive single-issue updates on the 3,000-issue fixture, pointer files included, measured with git rev-list --objects plus git cat-file --batch-check with the %(objecttype) %(objectsize) %(rest) template — the %(rest) field is required or the size lookup silently returns nothing.

Out of scope: any code change beyond test-infra fixes strictly needed to make the suite run green. If a scenario is red here, record the specific failure on the parent instead of expanding this slice.

issue.description:
ADR-005 is Accepted with no corresponding implementation bead. Add a `ready_frontier` check under doctor's `dependencies` scope that warns when `open` issues carry an assignee (a state excluded from the claimable frontier that no current diagnostic surfaces), names a bounded sample of offending ids, and states the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). The check must be advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Add a test locking the diagnose-don't-mutate behavior — an assigned open issue survives `doctor --repair` unchanged and the warning fires — plus a case asserting a legitimately parked assignment is reported rather than silently consumed.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the doctor ready_frontier check diagnosing assigned-but-open issues (ADR-005)
